context.roleEssence: This role owns delivery, coaching and operating rhythm for the Connectors team - 11 engineers building and maintaining the connectors and indexing capabilities that feed the Knowledge Hub. The job is fundamentally about the people on the team as much as the roadmap: running the operating cadence, coaching each engineer, and being accountable for reliable, on-time delivery of connector work that other product areas (Employee Assistant, Department Agents) depend on for governed data access. Expertise here means knowing each direct report well enough to coach them individually, while keeping the team's delivery and reliability KPIs on track.

onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence defines this role as directly accountable for coaching and managing these 11 people - these 1:1s are the core hands-on work of the role, not an introduction adjacent to it.

onboardingNeeds.title: Review open connectors roadmap and in-flight delivery commitments

onboardingNeeds.rationale: Exists because of the 1:1 relationships above - prepares for effective coaching conversations rather than being the meetings themselves; should sit alongside or just before the 1:1s begin.

onboardingNeeds.title: Meet your manager to align on team goals and expectations
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Align on what success looks like for the Connectors team and how you'll be supported as a new manager here.

onboardingNeeds.purpose: Understand how the Employee Assistant or Department Agents teams rely on connectors output day to day.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence highlights that connectors work feeds other GA/beta product areas - seeing that dependency from the consumer side clarifies why reliability matters.
